description: This Python source file contains utilities for managing unsharding, re-sharding, and handling flat parameters in the context of Fully Sharded Data-Parallel (FSDP) training within the PyTorch distributed module. It includes functions for registering/deregistering flat parameters, unsharding parameters temporarily, managing training states, and handling parameter write-back and offloading.

classes.name: FlatParamHandle
classes.description: A handle class for managing flattened parameters in FSDP, including unsharding, sharding, and associated metadata.

methods.name: _writeback_to_local_shard( handle: FlatParamHandle, writeback_grad: bool, )
methods.description: Writes back a rank's shard of a flattened parameter (and its gradient, if specified) to the sharded flattened parameter.

methods.name: None _deregister_flat_param(state: _FSDPState, module: nn.Module)
methods.description: Removes the flattened parameter attribute from the module without deleting the attribute, hiding it from nn.Module methods.

methods.name: None _register_flat_param(state: _FSDPState, module: nn.Module)
methods.description: Registers the flattened parameter to the module, making it visible to nn.Module methods.

methods.name: Generator _unflatten_as_params(state: _FSDPState, module: nn.Module)
methods.description: Context manager that temporarily deregisters flattened param and exposes original parameters as views.

methods.name: None _validate_unshard_params_args( state: _FSDPState, writeback: bool, rank0_only: bool, offload_to_cpu: bool, with_grads: bool, )
methods.description: Validates arguments used for unsharding parameters, raising errors for unsupported configurations.

methods.name: _unshard_fsdp_state_params( module: nn.Module, state: _FSDPState, writeback: bool, rank0_only: bool, offload_to_cpu: bool, with_grads: bool, )
methods.description: Context manager that handles unsharding parameters for a specific FSDP state and module.

methods.name: _unshard_params_for_summon( module: nn.Module, state: _FSDPState, writeback: bool, rank0_only: bool, offload_to_cpu: bool, with_grads: bool, )
methods.description: Context manager that handles unsharding parameters for a module to be used in summon operation.

methods.name: _unshard_params( module: nn.Module, recurse: bool, writeback: bool, rank0_only: bool, offload_to_cpu: bool, with_grads: bool, )
methods.description: Context manager that unshards FSDP-managed parameters for all modules in the tree.

methods.name: None _deregister_orig_params(state: _FSDPState, module: nn.Module)
methods.description: Deregisters original parameters and registers the flattened parameter.

methods.name: None _register_orig_params(state: _FSDPState, module: nn.Module)
methods.description: Deregisters the flattened parameter and registers the original parameters.
